result.title: Seeing Beyond the Obvious: Complementary Semantic Guidance for Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning
result.summary: Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SalSPML) assigns each image its most salient positive label, leaving other classes unlabeled. Existing methods construct class-level Salient Prototypes from observed positives to guide the recognition of unobserved classes. However, since salient annotations favor visually prominent instances, these prototypes may not fully capture the visual diversity of hidden positives, resulting in insufficient positive supervision. To address this limitation, we propose CoST, a Coverage-guided Complementary Soft-Target Refinement framework that supplements Salient Prototypes with complementary class-semantic information. Specifically, CoST identifies semantically relevant candidates from unknown classes by leveraging task-learned category information and image-text semantic correspondence. The selected candidates are then aggregated into class-wise Coverage Prototypes to complement the semantic representations provided by Salient Prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce a ranking-based selective refinement strategy that identifies classes receiving stronger semantic support from Coverage Prototypes and selectively enhances their soft targets while preserving the base soft targets for the rest. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CoST, with strong performance gains over existing baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 针对显著单正标签多标签学习（SalSPML）中显著原型覆盖不足的问题，提出 CoST 框架：借助任务学到的类别信息与图像-文本语义对应，从未标注类中筛选语义相关候选并聚合成 Coverage Prototypes，再用基于排序的选择性精修策略只增强语义支持较强的类的软目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用图像-文本语义对应筛选候选证据、并按支持强度选择性加强监督的思路，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与监督/贡献分配问题存在可借鉴联系，但论文属分类标签补全任务、无推理期状态生成，迁移价值需核查。
